pages.title: FAO SCHWARZ Jewellery Kit With Carrying Case - Pink
pages.description: Create your own fashion jewellery with the 56 bead compartments and over 2000 beads in this FAO Schwarz kit. Showcase your amazing styles on your special jewellery holder or wear them out. With 56 styles of beads, theres endless opportunities to get creative! Warning: contains small parts which can be a choking hazard. Suitable for ages 6+.
